responsibility: Provides the loop-structure and CFG manipulation utilities that the loop vectorizer uses to make a loop executable in vector form. It handles peeling, versioning, duplication and renaming of SSA names across copied loops, adjustment of PHIs and debug statements, preservation of loop-closed SSA form, splitting and fixing exit blocks, and creation of runtime checks such as aliasing, alignment, and cost guards that control entry into scalar versus vector loop versions. Because it rewrites loop shape and SSA/CFG structure, mistakes here can surface later in range, object-size, data-reference, or warning passes that consume the transformed loop.
same_name_distinction: Use this file when the suspicious behavior depends on loop versioning, peeling, copied-loop CFG/SSA repair, runtime checks, or scalar/vector loop control. Use tree-vect-loop.cc for loop vectorization analysis and transformation decisions, and use tree-vect-data-refs.cc or tree-vect-stmts.cc for memory-reference or statement-level vectorization details.
